"""Freeze fixed V164 reductions,all-unit audit and actual-viewing recorder."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1'
snapshot=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not snapshot.exists();snapshot.write_bytes((repo/'docs/pair-unit-floor.md').read_bytes())
names=['summarize-v163-final-v1.py','build-v163-tables-v1.py','paired-v163-regions-v1.py','quiet-dc-v163-final-v1.py',
    'record-v163-viewing-v1.py','route-v163-final-v1.py','compare-v163-retained-v1.py']
sources=[]
for old in names:
    p=repo/'.cache'/old.replace('v163','v164');assert not p.exists();s=(repo/'.cache'/old).read_text()
    s=s.replace('V163-harmonic-phase-v1','V164-pair-unit-floor-v1').replace('v163-harmonic-phase','v164-pair-unit-floor')
    s=s.replace('anchor-control','phase-control').replace('harmonic-phase','fine-pair')
    s=s.replace('Anchor ctrl raw','Phase ctrl raw').replace('Anchor ctrl EMA','Phase ctrl EMA').replace('Phase raw','Pair floor2 raw').replace('Phase EMA','Pair floor2 EMA')
    if old.startswith('paired') or old.startswith('compare') or old.startswith('record'):
        prefix="        'scope':" if old.startswith('record') else "    'scope':"
        a=s.index(prefix);b=s.index('\n',a)
        scope='All four fixed V164 endpoints. Current identical47-tensor phase heads/data/base losses differ only in paired-response unit floor16/2DN16;physical Charbonnier transition also scales. Exact V163 control. Historical contrasts mix architecture/data/loss. Related adaptive cohort,not independent scenes/significance. Every case and worst increase retained. Native viewing recorded only after original-detail inspection;both protected scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs,ISO100 qualitative refs,not exactGT. Eight retained native columns.'
        s=s[:a]+prefix+repr(scope)+'})'+s[b:]
    if old.startswith('compare'):
        needle="    'V162':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1','flat-anchor'),";assert needle in s
        s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V163':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1','harmonic-phase'),")
    ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=(repo/'.cache/review-v163-effects-v1.py').read_text().replace('V163-harmonic-phase-v1','V164-pair-unit-floor-v1')
s=s.replace('anchor-control','phase-control').replace('harmonic-phase','fine-pair')
s=s.replace("'training_mask_replay':ref(root/'training-mask-replay-v1.json'),'phase_removal':ref(root/'phase-removal-result-v1.json')", "'training_unit_and_mask_audit':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json')")
s=s.replace('Current comparison adds16 phase inputs/512 parameters at fixed V162 flat-anchor.25 data/loss. Extra capacity and compute part of intervention.',
    'Only pair-unit floor16/2DN16 changes at identical47-tensor V163 architecture/data/flat-anchor.25/base losses;physical Charbonnier transition also scales.')
p=repo/'.cache/review-v164-effects-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v164-training-units-v1.py';assert p.is_file();ast.parse(p.read_text());sources.append(ref(p))
save(root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json',{'status':'fixed-reductions-and-unit-audit-prepared-before-quality',
    'sources':sources,'protocol_snapshot':ref(snapshot),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Prepared9 fixed final reduction/unit-audit/viewing sources;not executed')
